levels.surface: أبو الحسن محمد بن سعيد بن عزيز لسمرقندي

notes: «بإسناده رفعه إلى» is a gap (rule 8): an unnamed link at its place, not filled from memory
the Imam is named inside the chain after «إلى», so he stays narrator
«الفقيه بأرض بلخ» is a title and place, left out; «أنه سأله رجل» puts the asker in the scene only, and the saying is the Imam's answer
